candidateVerification.candidate: Unchanged new-conversation input still navigates after HTTP acceptance or receipt-first cleanup and intervening render
candidateVerification.evidence: Workspace captures the sending render's canLeaveAfterAcceptance before awaiting. Exact accepted cleanup records before=A revision, after=the newly loaded empty revision; the captured predicate accepts that one successor even after setDraft causes a render. A later HTTP update finding no stored A does not emit a second clear. The two unchanged-A regressions cover HTTP and receipt first.

candidateVerification.candidate: New memory-only B, persisted B, all mutable fields, metadata changes and text ABA must stay with the original new-conversation owner
candidateVerification.evidence: All setters replace revision synchronously and persist immediately revokes acceptedClear before attempting storage. The captured send predicate compares current revision rather than text equality or render timing. The rejected handoff only installs a completion notice and refreshes the list; it does not change the draft key. The 24-case Workspace suite covers B, ABA, options, attachments, references, context, output schema, metadata and same-response-batch edits.

candidateVerification.candidate: Accepted-clear provenance must be restricted to the original input and its cleanup successor
candidateVerification.evidence: snapshot-cleared is honored only when event key and live revision match the current owner. load records before/after only for that exact cleared revision; a normal load drops provenance and every persist revokes it. canLeaveAfterAcceptance additionally requires the captured visit to remain active and live key equality. New edits after receipt clearance fail the old predicate.

candidateVerification.candidate: Pre-existing save failure and edits during Archive/Review/Branch operations must block automatic navigation
candidateVerification.evidence: Non-input canLeave requires !unsaved and exact captured revision as well as active visit/key. Archive captures it at operation start; Review/Branch async submits retain their submitting-render callbacks. Archive updates local archive selection and shows a manual-open notice when denied. New review/branch callbacks go through workflowHandoff; prior save failures cannot be bypassed merely by opening a fresh dialog.

candidateVerification.candidate: Manual open/recovery and original dialog callback contracts retain their intended behavior
candidateVerification.evidence: workflowOpenThread remains explicitly navigational with the existing navigation guard. Completed-result buttons call openThread directly. Real dialogs route only fresh successful creation through onCreatedThread/onCreatedFork; recovered review opening and branch retry use the original onOpenThread/onFork. Optional callbacks default to the original callbacks, preserving other callers. Existing real-dialog routing tests assert these distinctions.

candidateVerification.candidate: Navigation away and ABA return must not let old automatic responses pull the user back
candidateVerification.evidence: navigate and popstate increment navigation.current. send, archive and workflow handoffs compare their captured navigation identity; useDraft visit objects never regain activity on a later same-key visit. Real useWorkflow suppresses results once its dialog unmounts or owner changes. Workspace new-conversation leave/return tests and real-dialog unmount tests cover the relevant fences.

candidateVerification.candidate: Branch target text must be saved without replacing source composer data or losing branch source on write failure
candidateVerification.evidence: finishBranch writes the edit text under the returned target id and emits a notification with that id before attempting the handoff. The original composer's hook rejects another key's event. A target write failure returns false, so BranchDialog retains text and does not clear its source snapshot or close. On successful copy, only the exact saved branch source revision is cleared; a newer source revision survives. Denied automatic navigation can still close the dialog safely because the target text is durable and the original composer owner remains mounted.

candidateVerification.candidate: Cross-key draft notifications or old attachment cleanup must not replace volatile current input
candidateVerification.evidence: The hook rejects events for other keys. Same-key generic reload refuses to replace unsaved state. Attachment removal merges the deletion into current fields and preserves the storage-failure warning; snapshot clearing compares exact revisions. DraftsSettings' event listener reads and displays drafts only and does not write or re-dispatch.
